answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 12 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 660 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The raven test is the live device, the bridge test is the locked stake, and the nadir test is the graded history no template can fake.
